## Modules

- [Tribunal.EvalCase.Assertions](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.EvalCase.Assertions.md): ExUnit-style assertion macros for LLM evaluation.

- [Tribunal.Judge](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judge.md): Behaviour for LLM-as-judge assertions.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Bias](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Bias.md): Detects stereotypes and prejudice in LLM outputs.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Correctness](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Correctness.md): Compares LLM output against an expected answer.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Faithful](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Faithful.md): Evaluates whether LLM output is grounded in provided context.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Hallucination](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Hallucination.md): Detects claims not supported by the provided context.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Harmful](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Harmful.md): Detects dangerous or harmful content in LLM outputs.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Jailbreak](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Jailbreak.md): Detects when an LLM has been manipulated to bypass safety measures.
- [Tribunal.Judges.PII](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.PII.md): Detects Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in LLM outputs.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Refusal](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Refusal.md): Detects when an LLM appropriately refuses to comply with a request.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Relevant](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Relevant.md): Evaluates whether LLM output is relevant to the input query.
- [Tribunal.Judges.Toxicity](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Judges.Toxicity.md): Detects hostile, abusive, or toxic content in LLM outputs.

- Core
  - [Tribunal](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.md): LLM evaluation framework for Elixir.
  - [Tribunal.Assertions](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Assertions.md): Assertion evaluation engine.
  - [Tribunal.TestCase](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.TestCase.md): Represents a single evaluation test case.

- Assertion Types
  - [Tribunal.Assertions.Deterministic](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Assertions.Deterministic.md): Deterministic assertions that don't require LLM calls.
  - [Tribunal.Assertions.Embedding](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Assertions.Embedding.md): Embedding-based semantic similarity assertions.
  - [Tribunal.Assertions.Judge](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Assertions.Judge.md): LLM-as-judge assertions for evaluating LLM outputs.

- Testing
  - [Tribunal.Dataset](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Dataset.md): Loads evaluation datasets from JSON or YAML files.
  - [Tribunal.EvalCase](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.EvalCase.md): ExUnit integration for LLM evaluations.
  - [Tribunal.RedTeam](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.RedTeam.md): Red team attack generators for testing LLM safety.

- Reporters
  - [Tribunal.Reporter](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.md): Behaviour for eval result reporters.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.Console](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.Console.md): Pretty console output for eval results.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.GitHub](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.GitHub.md): GitHub Actions annotations format.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.HTML](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.HTML.md): HTML report for shareable results.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.JSON](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.JSON.md): JSON output for CI/machine consumption.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.JUnit](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.JUnit.md): JUnit XML format for CI tools.

  - [Tribunal.Reporter.Text](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Tribunal.Reporter.Text.md): Plain ASCII text output (no unicode).

## Mix Tasks

- [mix tribunal.eval](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tribunal.Eval.md): Runs LLM evaluations from dataset files.
- [mix tribunal.init](https://tribunal.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tribunal.Init.md): Creates the eval directory structure with example files.
